$comment: Helsinki city map (#913). Positions are normalized 0..1 on the map panel, arranged to match the real city's rough geography: Kallio/Sörnäinen north-east, Kamppi/Punavuori south, the university in the centre. Ordinary 1970s Helsinki: no invented districts. `visible_at_start` is true for exactly two nodes; everything else needs a discovery flag. The underground is `hidden_always_until` - it must not appear as a greyed marker.

nodes.name: Home, Helsinginkatu
nodes.description: A UNSA-provided flat you moved into yesterday. Boxes still stacked by the door, no pictures on the walls, a kitchen that smells of fresh paint and someone else's cleaning products. Helsinginkatu runs below the window: trams, kiosks, bar lights, and the long argument between the neighbourhood's working-class past and its gentrifying present.

nodes.name: UNSA HQ, Ratakatu
nodes.description: The former Suojelupoliisi headquarters on Ratakatu, now the UNSA Helsinki Field Office. The building has not decided whether it is SuPo's archive, a Europol liaison desk or a UN scientific agency, so it is all three at once: three badge colours, four filing systems, and a reception desk that is aggressively, blandly friendly.

nodes.name: Olutravintola Putki
nodes.description: Romppainen's bar, a fictional place in the orbit of the real student taverns. Students, lecturers, anarchists, exiles and people who have been arguing about the same paragraph since 1968. Cheap beer, loud theory.

nodes.name: University of Helsinki
nodes.description: Lecture halls, corridors, a department library that keeps its own rules. The place to find the person who knows the thing nobody else bothered to write down.

nodes.name: Kurvi
nodes.description: The crossroads where Kallio changes its mind about itself: working-class corners, nightlife, kiosks, a bohemian crowd that treats the whole junction as a living room.

nodes.name: UNSA Underground Complex
nodes.description: Layered archives and command spaces beneath the field office, reportedly in continuous use since about 1920. Not on any map the player is given until someone with clearance says so.
